from write_probe import bump
from write_probe import read
mut i := 0
mut total := 0
env_set("KUJO_ALLOCATION_PHASE", "4")
while i < 4096 { total += bump() i += 1 }
env_set("KUJO_ALLOCATION_PHASE", "5")
assert_equal(read(), 4096)
assert_equal(total, 8390656)
print("WRITE CAPTURE PASS")
